title: Implement POST /api/generate/batch/[id] route
description: Create the API route that triggers generation for all pending/failed prospects in a batch. Runs generation concurrently with a concurrency limit.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/generate/batch/[id] triggers generation for all pending+failed prospects
Each prospect is processed via the single-prospect pipeline
Verify by triggering and watching status updates in the DB

steps.details: Export POST handler. Load batch. Get all prospects with status 'pending' or 'failed'. Return 202 immediately. In background: run pipeline for each with concurrency=3.

Use a simple concurrency limiter: split prospects into chunks of 3, process each chunk with `Promise.all`, then proceed to the next chunk. Each item calls `runPipeline(prospect)` from the orchestrator.
Create a batch with 5 prospects. POST to endpoint. Poll prospect statuses. Verify all eventually reach 'ready' or 'failed' (not stuck at 'pending').
